subject: Re: Status: benchmark repro complete, one honest caveat for the LRB
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of the 6/24 LRB slot (Nadia has us confirmed):

1. We present ARL as an opt-in training mode with the "improves, not guarantees" framing verbatim from Yara's note. The synthetic non-identifiable-group case goes in the appendix, not hidden - I would rather the board poke at it with us in the room.
2. Emeka's tooling integration is the launch surface: config flag, adversary architecture defaults from the paper, and the worst-group AUC panel in the standard eval report.
3. Scope cut: the customer-facing "fairness score" idea is dead for this cycle. It compresses exactly the nuance Yara warned about into one number.
4. Q3 OKR: extend validation beyond tabular to one text classification workload.

The +2.9/+2.2 worst-group AUC numbers with flat overall AUC are the headline. Good work getting the honest version to be also the compelling version.

Dmitri
